name: fmp_commitment_of_traders
description:
CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) report for one futures market from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): positions of commercial and non-commercial traders by report date.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/cot-report as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (COT market symbol, e.g. ES).
For commodity prices use fmp_commodity_quote.
Example: {"symbol": "ES"}
